meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: Claude 会按代码的语法结构（而不是字面文字）来搜索和改写代码，覆盖 25 种语言；改写默认只给预览，需明确确认才真正写入文件。
howto.when: 当你按代码结构而非字面文本查找或改写时接管，例如形如 X 的调用、类、import；若目标是字符串、注释或文件名，原文建议改用 rg。

say.text: 找出仓库里所有空 catch 块
say.note: 按语法结构匹配，不是文字搜索

say.text: 跑一下项目的 YAML 规则，列出违规

howto.what_en: Claude searches and rewrites code by syntax structure instead of literal text, across 25 languages. Rewrites preview changes first and only write files when you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a syntax shape (a call, class, or import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x); show me a preview first
say_en.note: Default is preview only; no files changed

say_en.text: Find all empty catch blocks in the repo
say_en.note: Matches by syntax tree, not text

say_en.text: Run the project's YAML rules and list violations
